title: Finite step graph stability and image robustness in dermoscopic classification

author.name: Caglar Uyulan
author.affiliation: Faculty of Engineering and Architecture, Department of Mechanical Engineering, İzmir Katip Celebi University, İzmir, Türkiye

primary_claim: Mechanistic assessment of propagation stability versus complete image classification robustness, without a superiority or deployment claim
development_pool: Original DermaMNIST-C train and validation images, excluding the historical internal test set
development_partition: Repeated stratified lesion-grouped partitions with disjoint training, tuning and calibration sets; 7-fold outer tuning and 6-fold inner calibration
augmentation: Common graph and image rotations by multiples of 90 degrees and horizontal flips, sampled per minibatch from an independent generator
model_selection: Highest tuning macro F1; separate calibration data used only after checkpoint selection
baseline_initialization: All networks trained from scratch without external pretraining; torchvision ResNet18 and MobileNetV3 Small evaluated on the same native 28 by 28 inputs
sensitivity_scope: Development tuning only; no test based hyperparameter selection or redesign
isolation_conditions: A clean graph and clean nodes
B corrupted graph and clean nodes
C clean graph and corrupted nodes
D corrupted graph and corrupted nodes
independent_protocol: DermaMNIST-E official test set evaluated without fitting to E; audit source image IDs, lesion IDs when available, exact pixel hashes, labels and nearest image similarities; report benchmark shift without claiming prospective or independent clinical center validation
uncertainty: 1000 paired lesion-cluster bootstrap replicates for fixed probability ensembles plus separate mean and standard deviation across 10 training partitions and seeds; classwise sensitivity specificity precision F1 AUC; classwise calibration and ECE uncertainty
timing_scope: CPU batch one, image decoding, descriptor or graph construction and network inference, with model process peak memory; no mobile energy claims
reproducibility: Local full code and results package with exact hashes; no fabricated public archive or registration identifier
